reviews.summary: No current, directly asset-level exploit, outage, supply-unlock, regulatory, or RLC-EUR venue disruption was identified. A prior Phemex RLC/USDT delisting is venue-specific and not evidence of a current RLC-EUR trading halt.

facts.fact: Asset identity is high confidence: RLC is iExec’s ERC-20 utility token; official documentation states a fixed ~87M maximum supply with no pending unlocks or private allocations. ([docs.iex.ec](https://docs.iex.ec/get-started/overview/rlc?utm_source=openai))

No fresh official iExec incident or security advisory indicating a protocol/token compromise was found; the official GitHub organization shows active project repositories updated through October 5, 2026. ([github.com](https://github.com/iexecblockchaincomputing?utm_source=openai))

Phemex announced removal of its RLC/USDT spot pair effective September 15, 2026, including closed deposits and withdrawals. This does not establish impairment of the supplied RLC-EUR market, whose venue was not specified. ([phemex.com](https://phemex.com/announcements/phemex-will-delist-the-perp-usdt-spot-pair-100380?utm_source=openai))

The Bellecour↔Ethereum RLC bridge sunset occurred July 2, 2026; it is an already-completed network-path change rather than a newly announced event. ([iex.ec](https://iex.ec/blog/closing-a-chapter-opening-a-new-era?utm_source=openai))
